## 简体中文

- 修复 Apple Silicon Mac 启动后立即闪退的问题。文件拖放初始化现在保留原生 WebView 的运行时类型，仅替换拖放回调，避免触发 AppKit 视图属性断言。
- GitHub Actions 在完整应用签名、DMG 和更新归档检查之后，新增打包应用的实际启动检查。Apple Silicon 和 Intel 版本均在对应架构的 Mac 上执行，启动失败会阻止发布为 Latest。
- 同一修复的测试包已在 M1 Max、macOS 15.0 上确认正常打开，并通过云端 macOS 15 / 26 Apple Silicon 和 macOS 15 Intel 的签名与启动检查。

macOS 安装：遇到 v1.10.5 启动闪退的用户，请下载 v1.10.6 对应架构的 DMG，将应用复制到“应用程序”并替换旧版。本版本继续使用完整临时签名，尚未使用 Developer ID 签名或通过 Apple 公证；首次启动可能仍需在“系统设置 → 隐私与安全性 → 仍要打开”中允许运行。

## English

- Fix an immediate startup crash on Apple Silicon Macs. Native file-drop initialization now preserves the WebView's runtime class and replaces only drag-and-drop callbacks, avoiding an AppKit view-property assertion.
- Add an actual packaged-app startup check to GitHub Actions after verifying the complete app signature, DMG and updater archive. Apple Silicon and Intel builds run on Macs of the matching architecture; a startup failure blocks publication as Latest.
- A test build with the same fix was confirmed to open normally on an M1 Max running macOS 15.0. It also passed cloud signature and startup checks on macOS 15 / 26 Apple Silicon and macOS 15 Intel.

macOS installation: if v1.10.5 crashes at startup, download the v1.10.6 DMG matching your Mac's architecture and replace the old app in Applications. This release continues to use a full ad-hoc signature without Developer ID signing or Apple notarization; the first launch may still require **System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway**.
